newsitem.title: USA: GILLETTE TAKES NORELCO TO COURT OVER ADS.
newsitem.headline: GILLETTE TAKES NORELCO TO COURT OVER ADS.

text.p: The Gillette Co said on Wednesday that it filed a lawsuit against Norelco Consumer Products Co in a U.S. District Court, alleging Norelco used a false and disparaging advertising campaign for its electric razor.
Gillette said the suit, filed in a Massachusetts District Court on October 9, sought to stop the ads, and sought punitive and other damages.
The suit alleged Norelco's print and broadcast ad campaign was deceptive in promoting the new product, Gillette said.
Connecticut-based Norelco, a unit of Philips Electronics NV , said it was against company policy to comment on pending litigation.
John Darman, vice president, business management of Gillette's blades and razors segment, said the advertising was intended to harm the reputation of Gillette and its wet-shaving products.

"Norelco's new advertising takes direct aim at wet-shaving systems, including Gillette products, with a barrage of offensive, exaggerated and distorted statements and images focused on irritation and performance," said Darman.
